framework: US NIST SP 800-218A (SSDF Community Profile for generative AI, July 2024)
requirement_paraphrase: Recommends verifying integrity and provenance of acquired AI models and scanning and testing them for vulnerabilities and malicious content before use.

framework: US NIST SP 800-218A (SSDF Community Profile for generative AI, July 2024)
requirement_paraphrase: Recommends frequent scanning and testing of AI models for undetected vulnerabilities after release and periodic audits.

framework: US OMB M-25-22 (Driving Efficient Acquisition of AI in Government, 3 April 2025)
clause_or_page: Sec. 4(d) Selection and Award, Testing and Evaluation (p. 9, as rendered by fetch tool)
requirement_paraphrase: Agencies must, to the greatest extent practicable, test proposed AI solutions during proposal evaluation to understand capabilities and limits. Binds agencies; qualified by practicability.

framework: US OMB M-25-22 (Driving Efficient Acquisition of AI in Government, 3 April 2025)
clause_or_page: Sec. 4(d) Contract Terms, item E Ongoing Testing and Monitoring (p. 10, as rendered by fetch tool)
requirement_paraphrase: Contract terms must give the agency ability to regularly monitor and evaluate AI performance, risks and effectiveness; vendors must provide access and time for evaluation, using agency-defined data resembling deployment data.

framework: US OMB M-25-22 (Driving Efficient Acquisition of AI in Government, 3 April 2025)
clause_or_page: Sec. 4(e), Authorization To Operate Compliance (p. 11, as rendered by fetch tool)
requirement_paraphrase: AI systems and services operated as an information system must receive an authorization to operate before deployment.

framework: US OMB M-25-22 (Driving Efficient Acquisition of AI in Government, 3 April 2025)
requirement_paraphrase: Where practicable, agencies should seek detailed demonstrations and tests of AI products in realistic environments before award.

framework: US OMB M-25-22 (Driving Efficient Acquisition of AI in Government, 3 April 2025)
requirement_paraphrase: Agencies are encouraged to require vendors to meet performance standards before deployment, and to monitor performance with rollback options.

framework: US White House America's AI Action Plan (July 2025)
clause_or_page: Pillar I, Build an AI Evaluations Ecosystem (p. 10)
requirement_paraphrase: Directs NIST/CAISI to publish guidelines so agencies can conduct their own AI evaluations, support evaluation science, and convene evaluation-practice meetings; policy goals for government, not obligations on developers.

framework: US White House America's AI Action Plan (July 2025)
